title: FizzBuzz for one number
prompt: If n is divisible by both 3 and 5 return "FizzBuzz". If only by 3 return "Fizz". If only by 5 return "Buzz". Otherwise return the number itself as text, like "7".
hints: Check the both case first, or the later checks steal it.
`if n % 15 == 0:` then `elif n % 3 == 0:` then `elif n % 5 == 0:` then else.
str(n) turns a number into text.

docs.name: if condition:
docs.what: Runs the indented lines below it only when the condition is true. elif and else add more branches.
